pages.text:
A Conduit Cover hides a conduit inside a block. The conduit keeps working and connecting exactly as before.
- Right-click a conduit with a cover to encase it. By default it shows as a clear pane with a steel outline, so you can see it's there.
- Right-click the cover with any full, solid block to make it look like that block. It only takes the look: it's still a cover, and you keep the block.
- Sneak-right-click it with an empty hand to go back to the clear pane.
- The Wrench in Dismantle mode takes the cover off and gives it back. Breaking the conduit drops the cover too.
- Covers keep their look through chunk reloads and restarts.
Crafted 8 at a time from steel plates and glass.
